```php
<?php

namespace App\Models;

use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Factories\HasFactory;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\SoftDeletes;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Str;

class User extends Model
{
    use HasFactory, SoftDeletes;

    protected $fillable = [
        'name',
        'email',
        'password',
        'created_at',
        'updated_at',
    ];

    // Generate a unique identifier for each user using Laravel's UUID generator
    public function generateUuid()
    {
        return Str::uuid();
    }

    // Custom method to create a new user with a generated UUID
    public static function createUser($name, $email)
    {
        $user = User::create([
            'name' => $name,
            'email' => $email,
            'password' => bcrypt('password'), // Hash the password for security
            'uuid' => $user->generateUuid(),
        ]);

        return $user;
    }
}
```
